result.instructions: Tools for Wagepoint, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which employees have time entries waiting for approval this week?"; "Show the time-off balances for everyone in our main company."; "List the pending time-off requests for next month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Wagepoint data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run wagepoint_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run wagepoint_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run wagepoint_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. wagepoint_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: wagepoint_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List the Wagepoint companies this token can access, with id, name, company_code and status. Call this first to get a company_id. Wagepoint API: GET /v1/companies.

status.description: Filter by one company status, snake_case (e.g. active).

after.description: Opaque cursor: pass the page_info.after value from the previous response, unchanged. Do not build it yourself.

tools.name: wagepoint_get_company
tools.title: Get a company
tools.description: Get one company by id: name, DBA, company_code, status, phone number, primary address, locations and created_at. Wagepoint API: GET /v1/companies/{company_id}.

tools.name: wagepoint_list_persons
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List the people (employees and contractors) of a company: name, email, person_type, status, hire_date and address. Returns page_info; pass page_info.after to get the next page while has_more is true. Wagepoint API: GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/persons.

after.description: Opaque cursor: pass the page_info.after value from the previous response, unchanged. Do not build it yourself.

tools.name: wagepoint_list_pay_groups
tools.title: List pay groups
tools.description: List the pay groups of a company with id, name and is_auto_run. Wagepoint API: GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/pay-groups.

tools.name: wagepoint_list_time_entries
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List time entries for a company in a date window (from_date to to_date, both inclusive), optionally for some people or statuses. Each entry has id, person_id, work_date, duration, hours, notes and status (pending, edited, approved, paid, rejected). Wagepoint API: GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/time-entries.

to_date.description: End of the window, yyyy-mm-dd (inclusive). On or after from_date.

tools.name: wagepoint_create_time_entries
tools.title: Create time entries
tools.description: WRITE: create time entries for people in a company. Each entry needs person_id and work_date (yyyy-mm-dd) and a duration (ISO-8601, e.g. PT8H) or hours (decimal, legacy). Affects payroll data. Pass idempotencyKey to make a retry safe. Wagepoint API: POST /v1/companies/{company_id}/time-entries.

duration.description: ISO-8601 duration, e.g. PT8H or PT8H30M.

entries.description: The time entries to create (1 to 100).

idempotencyKey.description: Sent as the Idempotency-Key header. Reuse the same key to retry without duplicates.

tools.name: wagepoint_update_time_entry_status
tools.title: Approve or reject time entries
tools.description: WRITE: change the status of time entries: approve, unapprove or reject, for the given time_entry_ids. Affects payroll approval. Pass idempotencyKey to make a retry safe. Wagepoint API: PATCH /v1/companies/{company_id}/time-entries/status.

notes.description: Optional note saved with the change.

idempotencyKey.description: Sent as the Idempotency-Key header. Reuse the same key to retry without duplicates.

tools.name: wagepoint_list_time_off_requests
tools.title: List time-off requests
tools.description: List time-off requests for a company in a date window (from_date to to_date, both inclusive). Filter by status (pending, approved, rejected, cancelled, modified) or requester. Wagepoint API: GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/time-off-requests.

to_date.description: End of the window, yyyy-mm-dd (inclusive). On or after from_date.

requested_by_person_id.description: Only requests by this person id.

tools.name: wagepoint_get_time_off_request
tools.title: Get a time-off request
tools.description: Get one time-off request by id, with its policy, status and lines. Wagepoint API: GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/time-off-requests/{request_id}.

tools.name: wagepoint_list_company_time_off_balances
tools.title: List company time-off balances
tools.description: List the time-off balances of every person in a company: policy name, policy type, unlimited flag and current balance (total_balance_duration, ISO-8601). Wagepoint API: GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/time-off-balances.

tools.name: wagepoint_list_person_time_off_balances
tools.title: List a person's time-off balances
tools.description: List the time-off balances of one person: policy name, policy type, unlimited flag and current balance (total_balance_duration, ISO-8601). Wagepoint API: GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/persons/{person_id}/time-off-balances.
